diagnosis: Git LFS ls-tree -l scans lazily hydrate ordinary Git blobs serially in blob:none partial clones before LFS filtering. Mechanism reproduced: 14 remote fetches in 15 seconds; no-size scan takes 2.6ms with no fetches. Original timeout stage timing is reconstructed because no original trace existed.
future_prevention: Shallow clone without blob:none and with GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1; explicitly download only requested LFS paths.
